subdivision_of_building:
The proposals do not relate to any buildings.
This only relates to replacing old floodlights on courts 1 to 4 with LED lights.
Courts 5 and 6 already have LED lights and are not included.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed OptiVision LED floodlights by Signify received 5th November 2025, GardenTennis Club 4 Courts LTA 6.7m BVP657 by Signify received 23rd March 2026, Email titled LIGHTING DETAILS received 13th January 2026
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 3 - The floodlighting hereby approved shall be installed, operated and maintained strictly in accordance with the approved lighting assessment and associated plans demonstrating acceptable levels of light spill. No external lighting shall be used on the site other than that shown in the approved details.

Reason: To protect the amenity of neighbouring occupiers, safeguard the character of the area, minimise light pollution, and avoid adverse impacts on biodiversity, in accordance with policies LP2, LP10, LP14, LP53 and LP55 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 4 - The floodlighting shall not be altered, re angled, replaced, upgraded or operated at a higher output than specified in the approved lighting report without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To protect the amenity of neighbouring occupiers, safeguard the character of the area, minimise light pollution, and avoid adverse impacts on biodiversity, in accordance with policies LP2, LP10, LP14, LP53 and LP55 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 5 - The floodlighting shall only be illuminated between the hours of 0800-2100 and when in use, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To protect the amenity of neighbouring occupiers, safeguard the character of the area, minimise light pollution, and avoid adverse impacts on biodiversity, in accordance with policies LP2, LP10, LP14, LP53 and LP55 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 6 - The floodlighting shall be fitted with the louvres as specified in the approved details to prevent glare, upward light and unnecessary illumination of neighbouring properties, the wider townscape or nearby green infrastructure.

Reason: To protect the amenity of neighbouring occupiers, safeguard the character of the area, minimise light pollution, and avoid adverse impacts on biodiversity, in accordance with policies LP2, LP10, LP14, LP53 and LP55 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
description:
The proposal is to upgrade old fashioned outdoor sportslighting with new, energy efficient lighting.
The Gardens Lawn Club currently has old floodlights on 4 tennis courts. Each court has 6 lights so 24 lights in total. These are expensive to run as they are not energy efficient. They are difficult to maintain as replacement bulbs and other parts are no longer available.
We wish to replace them with LED lights which will be much more energy efficient and require less maintenance. This proposal will significantly reduce the clubs electricity consumption and improve environmental sustainability.
LED lights will provide similar levels of light to what is currently provided. Improved design will result in reduced light spillage for our neighbours. The new lighting will meet current specifications set out by the Lawn Tennis Association. 
The proposal is for courts 1 to 4. We have two other courts (5 and 6) which already have LED lights and are not part of this proposal.
There are no buildings involved in this proposal.

application_details.scheme_name: LED Lighting Upgrade on Courts 1 to 4
